exposure: fasting plasma glucose (FPG) levels of 5.1-5.5 mmol/L
women with FPG levels of 5.1-5.5 mmol/L
International Association of Diabetic Pregnancy Study Group (IADPSG) diagnostic criteria
UK National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) criteria
outcome: gestational diabetes mellitus diagnosis (using IADPSG and NICE criteria)
cohort: 4646 pregnant women who underwent a 2-hour 75-g oral glucose tolerance test at 24-32 weeks of a singleton pregnancy
finding: Women with fasting plasma glucose levels between 5.1-5.5 mmol/L, while not diagnosed with GDM by NICE criteria, had an increased risk of adverse outcomes like large-for-gestational-age newborns and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women with fasting plasma glucose levels of 5.1-5.5 mmol/L had higher odds of cesarean delivery compared to a control group.
